policies.text: Third-party risk clearance is awarded when an entity provides an annual clean third-party risk review.
Cross-border trading eligibility is granted to a firm possessing a valid customs broker license.

Standard vetting approval is passed either by maintaining FINRA broker-dealer registration, paying annual compliance fees of at least $100,000, and holding an active Anti-Money Laundering compliance certification, or by submitting a clean third-party risk review.
Merchant payment processing permission requires a minimum rolling reserve balance of $250,000.
Institutional onboarding approval is issued to an entity that satisfies institutional oversight benchmark.
Minimum capital qualification is satisfied when a firm maintains custodian assets of at least $80,000,000.
Preferred market maker status is granted to an entity reaching tier-one participant designation.

Flawless compliance record is achieved when an entity holds an active Anti-Money Laundering compliance certification, records no more than 1 annual regulatory fine, and completes at least 10 annual internal audit inspections.
Institutional oversight benchmark is met when an entity with baseline regulatory clearance receives an institutional audit rating of 80 points or higher.
SEC advisory status is granted to an entity holding active SEC investment adviser registration.
Fiduciary leadership endorsement is awarded when an institution maintains a board evaluation score of 90 points or higher and executes ethical conduct reviews.

Fundamental account qualification is established if an entity employs at least 8 certified compliance officers, or maintains FINRA broker-dealer registration, or holds equity assets under management of at least $40,000,000.
Tier-one participant designation is assigned when an entity maintaining flawless compliance record also holds prime brokerage authorization.
Capital adequacy requirements are fulfilled when an entity possesses net capital of at least $1,500,000.
High-volume clearing access is conferred upon an entity meeting comprehensive governance criteria that holds an operational loss reserve of at least $400,000.
Comprehensive governance criteria are satisfied when an entity with operational security endorsement achieves an annual staff compliance training rate of at least 90%.
Prime brokerage authorization is granted if an entity holding institutional onboarding approval also satisfies capital adequacy requirements.
Validated account standing is conferred upon an entity that establishes fundamental account qualification.
Corporate credit facility access is extended to an entity obtaining validated account standing.
Baseline regulatory clearance is granted if an entity maintains FINRA broker-dealer registration and pays annual compliance fees of at least $100,000.
Operational security endorsement is attained if an entity holding third-party risk clearance also completes standard vetting approval.
